title: Chroma Retrieval and MMR
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of candidate retrieval, diversity, and relevance, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in college-faq-chatbot-rag.
learning_objectives: Explain candidate retrieval, diversity, and relevance in plain language and connect it to src/vector_store.py; src/retriever.py.
Trace one input through the chroma retrieval and mmr stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the chroma retrieval and mmr stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for candidate retrieval, diversity, and relevance.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
